stories.title: Burnham to ask for update on killer's sentence review
stories.summary: Driver Aleksanders Dolars was jailed for nine years four months for killing Keaton Slater, 12, in a crash.

stories.title: Brain cancer patients demand public inquiry into chemotherapy scandal
stories.summary: A wider review of affected patients should be discussed with the government, the report recommends.

stories.title: 'Bonkers' Shakespeare Institute move must end, says actor
stories.summary: Samuel West is spearheading a petition against the move with more than 16,000 signatures.

stories.summary: The Air Ambulance Service charity said the new Catthorpe site was urgently needed.

stories.title: Deaf sports award nomination 'shows no limit to what I can achieve'

stories.title: Asylum hotel to close within weeks

stories.title: Abattoir worker sentenced for walking on sheep
